name: explainer-video
description: Narrated explainer and guide videos of a web app: Playwright drives the real UI with a visible cursor; a camera zooms on what matters; callouts, a spotlight and marks are drawn on the word that names them; chapters, preview and recap cards, and flowchart, terminal and code scenes explain what the UI cannot; a local Kokoro 82M voice (af_heart) reads the script with captions that follow it word by word. Recorded at 1920x1080 in slow motion for smooth motion and built into a web-sized H.264 MP4 with chapters, captions, a transcript, a poster and an embed page; a dry run also gives a written guide and a click-through walkthrough. The skill says which effects suit which video, and includes the voice setup check and installer, the tour kit, voicing, build and verify scripts, templates, and the traps behind each rule.
